title: Mazda 6E GT (560km) $52990 Driveaway @ Mazda
body:
Deal: Mazda 6E GT (560km) $52990 Driveaway @ Mazda

[MrZ] No thanks, I'm too busy enjoying my tin can $19,990 Atto 1
[lNomNoml] Yeah I wouldn't say a car for $52990 is a bargin.
[safrane] It's a Mazda, not a Toyota, and this is definitely not Mazda at its best.
It's an outsourced, badge-engineered vehicles which Mazda needs, because they have almost zero EV expertise.
[Poor Ass] Actually they had mx30 back in 2021 but it was a total flop
Now the Mazda EV is 50% Mazda 50% Changan
[billy_bob] @Poor Ass: More like 80% Changan, 20% Mazda.
[zachhambo] 2015kg 7.6s 0-100, bit faster and lighter than a tank
[Bargainian] Who are these hoons complaining about 0-100 in 7.6s? This is as fast as Golf GTIs from 2010s.
[Poor Ass] Golf R is the hoons choice at every red light
[SetTheFaqUp] @Poor Ass: RS3 too. Limping part time "AWD".
[PapaWill] Maybe 1990s-2000s GTIs
2010s GTIs are 6.2-6.4 seconds even for the manual.
My MK7 Clubsport is 5.8 I believe.
[SetTheFaqUp] @PapaWill: Ah… Just as quick as the Camry.
[PapaWill] @SetTheFaqUp: I daily a Camry Hybrid as a work vehicle
Camry is a boat
[Bargainian] @PapaWill: 2008 GTI manual had 7.2s, but auto was faster at 6.9s, and that was until 2012. It got faster from 2013 onwards.
[PapaWill] @Bargainian: I've owned a MK5 and 2 MK7's - I got it ;)
[MkVIGTI] @PapaWill: Nope, my 2010 MkVI GTI was 6.9s with the DSG. Manual would be 7+s. 155kw with 280Nm only.
[PapaWill] @MkVIGTI: Chill… The MK6 GTI is gonna do 0-100 quicker than 7.6
[Its not unusable] The old 2.5 tubro Mazda6 do 7.1s to 0-100.
2.5NA is around 8s.
Not that bad.
[King Tightarse] 190kW for a medium sized family sedan is reasonably sprightly
[Musiclover] I agree it is a bit crap, only recommended if you specifically want Mazda for some obscure reason (when in fact it is Deepal)… Mazda has never been competitive on tech in modern EVs, but at least they are lowering the price to compete on value.
[Wiadro] LOL, no thanks, ill buy the chinese brand equivalent
[bumluffa] Same as tesla. Why buy American or Japanese branded Chinese car when you can just buy a proper Chinese car.
[Koppeldread] @bumluffa: All Chinese cars are just tesla knock offs. True, Tesla has one of its three factories in China, but it is not like they are just slapping a tesla badge on an existing platform like Mazda has here.
[BargainHunterMYz] Well I considered both. This is a fastback vs seal that's a sedan. Plus byd seal interior is quite dated now.
[discountguy] Currently $57k driveaway according to the BYD website
[robotojones] I believe it is the same platform as the Denza.
How good or bad of platform that is? 🤷‍♂️
[MkVIGTI] Deepal not Denza. Deepal is from Changan and Denza is from BYD so completely different brands.
[utsc] Denza is Premium BYD - Similar to Lexus which is Premium Toyota
[J0hn] wish more ev cars have around min 500+ range under 50k mark. maybe in couple more years
[Lofty248] Feels like the days of coachbuilders are coming back.
[tekisei] Would have to wait for the Zeekr 7GT at this point for a full EV, otherwise that BYD PHEV Seal wagon.
[DannyBoy] That Zeekr 7GT rear is hideous though…
https://editorial.pxcrush.net/carsales/general/editorial/zee…
[Eeples] Considering Australia’s version of the 7GT’s 0-100 it is likely only the rear will be visible.
[Autonomic] The SL7 can be had for $55k D/A.
Why would anyone pick this over that? Genuine question.
[BargainHunterMYz] Some people like me don't like to drive suv and prefer lower seating position.
[BargainSnatcher] The EV you’ve been waiting for is “almost here”.
Electrify every drive with exhilarating precision and power, the latest driving technology, and signature Kodo design in the All-Electric Mazda 6e.
Says it all thanks Mazda and that rear end boot with electric spoiler looool
[donman92] At this price point you're better off going with the Xpeng G6; faster, more boot space, better driving tech ans significantly more powerful.
[jackary] What about the Leapmotor B05? Took one for a drive recently and man, its a great package. We all need to stop drinking the SUV koolaid, a sedan or hatch is just so much nicer to drive most of the time.
Suspension tune by Maserati… allegedly.
[Larsson] I have to admit, I have been enjoying the downfall and absolute fumble of the traditional brands in the automotive market and EV specifically.
Years of overcharging people for below average sht boxes are coming to head. Enjoyable to watch.
[Mysterious Laptop] Hit the nail on the head. Only brand I still see getting away with it is Toyota.
[PerthectDeal] Yep Mazda wanted to charge me over $200 to update the maps 1 month out of warrenty, the sign at the service desk said "service with us to get your software updates", I had been servicing it for 3 years with them and the sales adviser said ah yes, for the maps you have to ask for it separately. They would not budge.. Also always wanted to charge more that the set price servicing.. So glad I moved to Tesla. $150 servicing cost in 3.5 years..
[twig] Mazda Australia had to be dragged kicking and screaming to hybrids and EVs.
They've been selling hybrids in other countries for a decade but we got none of it until Labor passed the vehicle emissions standards.
I liked their cars but don't think I would go back to Mazda.
[Eleven55] Personally, I don't think the 6e is great, but it's not terrible. It's got a few Mazda quirks, but misses the simplicity and brilliance that Mazda is known for. That being a no-frills, quality experience.
I hope it does well enough for them to start investing in their own EV cars built from the ground up. I don't need a fancy electric car that with no buttons, a giant iPad, self-driving, and a weird aesthetic. I just need a 'car'. A car that runs on batteries instead of petrol.
[Anubizz] Well you can buy mx30 EV with 200 km WLTP, as Mazda drivers I believe Mazda goes into wrong way since they start producing 2 digit model.
